prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1012; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you were involved in. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where the incident occurred.

A: It was in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center off the main road.

Q: Can you describe what you were doing just before the collision?

A: I had just pulled into a parking space and was backing out to leave. I checked my mirrors and started slowly in reverse.

Q: What happened next?

A: Another vehicle came down the aisle behind me and its rear bumper struck the driver's side of my car. It wasn't going fast, but there was a solid impact.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injuries immediately after the impact?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck started to ache, and by the next morning I had stiffness and pain running into my shoulders. Turning my head to the side is difficult.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening and was later referred to a physical therapist. I was diagnosed with whiplash.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back injuries?

A: No, nothing that required treatment before this.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to make sure my medical bills and time off work get properly documented. I have the records and can send them over.

Q: Thank you. We will follow up once we receive those documents.

A: Thank you.
